sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For generations, our family foundry has built its reputation on pride, craftsmanship, and the deep ties we share with long-standing partners in our region like Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. 

We can now present our offer with a price of €51.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this tailored Angebot reflects both the strong heritage of our partnership and our commitment to working together for years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We appreciate your revised offer and the step you have taken towards us. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are pleased to make a further concession to €51.30 per unit. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot provides a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We believe this price reflects a fair balance and look forward to your confirmation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement and are pleased to make another step towards you. For generations, our foundry has taken immense pride in delivering reliable quality to valued regional partners like Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

We can offer a revised price of €50.90 per unit. Along with this price, our offer includes a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and it is valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We believe this brings us very close to a fair agreement that honors our long-standing partnership. Our entire team would be delighted to continue our shared history and support your production with the craftsmanship you have trusted for so many years.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
